sources.title: On the future of solutions to the massless Einstein-Vlasov system in a Bianchi I cosmology
read_locations: Section2.1 conserved covariant momenta and Einstein equations
sources.convention_mapping: Paper uses 8piG=c=1 and k_ab=+dotg_ab/2. BASS a_perp=a exp(-b),a_parallel=a exp(2b),q=s/H. Previously verified q=2Sigma_plus,A=6w_plus preserved. Our manufactured positive donor and new finite angular birth rules are additional stated numerical-model ingredients.

sources.title: On the differentiability of phi-projections in the discrete finite case
sources.verified_content: Interior unique finite projections with invertible constrained Hessian admit an implicit Jacobian. Linear equality sets with a positive interior fall within the stated framework.
sources.mapping_and_limit: Their fixed equality-set sensitivity is a primary comparison, not a ready-made BASS moving-support formula. We directly differentiate both q(b) and T(b) and retain the additional mean(T_b)+Cov(T,v) terms. Positive covariance and strict support feasibility are explicit hypotheses. No novelty or global boundary-smoothness claim.

sources.title: NIST Digital Library of Mathematical Functions, Section3.5 Quadrature
sources.verified_content: Gauss nodes are zeros of the corresponding orthogonal polynomial, the weights are positive, and the rule is exact for degree at most2n−1. The Legendre weight is1 on[-1,1].
sources.scope: Supports standard finite GL node/weight construction only. Moving angular map, KL correction, finite-d accuracy and native finite-bin ledgers are checked by our specific derivations and experiments.
